verdict.rationale: Capacities hosts an interactive API reference at api.capacities.io/docs, rendered from its published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, with authenticated try-it: you paste a cap-api token in the Bearer Token field to make live requests. The successor portal at developers.capacities.io advertises an interactive OpenAPI spec with TypeScript SDK samples for every endpoint. The 404s on docs.capacities.io OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at api.capacities.io. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the try-it console and runnable samples work, and more detail on the successor portal (the current Beta reference is being discontinued September 1, 2026).
